nodes.name: Write forecast features
nodes.notes: on_conflict MUST match a unique index on exactly those columns. This said city_key,for_date,source,lead_days and the table's only unique index is its primary key (city_key, for_date, run_at) - so every write here failed with 42P10 and no forecast feature was ever stored for a non-US city. P1.4 already used the primary key; this now matches it.
